messages:
Priya (Docs): Quick note 9: found a couple of live issues in the Dedicated provisioning docs: 2 broken internal anchors, an autoscale YAML that uses old keys, and a TS SDK snippet that calls createDedicatedPool. Opening a small PR to patch these.
Marcus (ENG): which keys are outdated?
Priya (Docs): autoscale uses `scalePolicy` and `tenant_id`. The new schema is `scale_policies` (list) and `tenant_label`. Also the docs mention preemption but don't state reserved vs shared behavior.
Talia (Infra): here's a compact corrected autoscale snippet for the handbook:
Talia (Infra): ```yaml
annotations:
  redwood.com/isolation: "reserved-pool"
scale_policies:
  - name: default
    min_replicas: 1
    max_replicas: 6
```
Diego (ML): small wording change: the quantization paragraph references an outdated model family. Replace with: "Use per-workload quant profiles and run perf/quality sweeps before applying globally." Two sentences.
Priya (Docs): plan: 1) fix anchors, 2) swap in Talia's trimmed YAML, 3) update TS sample to use `reserveCapacity` and show `{ poolId }` return shape, 4) add a one-line migration callout at the top, 5) add a tiny bullet about eviction precedence (reserved: not preempted; shared: preempted). Will push later today.
doc-bot: link-check: passed on branch priya/provisioning-slimline :white_check_mark:
Marcus (ENG): please keep the example under 30 lines and link to an appendix for detailed rationale.
Talia (Infra): will do.
Priya (Docs): thanks all 90 will ping reviewers when PR is ready.
